functional_requirements.title: Real-time system metrics dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Display CPU usage (%), RAM (used/total), Disk per partition, Network traffic (bytes in/out per interface), and CPU temperature — all updating every 5 seconds via SSE without page reload.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows CPU usage percentage with 60-minute historical chart
Dashboard shows RAM used/total with percentage and chart
Dashboard shows disk usage per partition (used/total/percentage)
Dashboard shows network traffic (bytes in/out per second) per interface
Dashboard shows CPU temperature in Celsius with color indicator: green < 60°C, yellow 60–75°C, red > 75°C
Metrics update automatically every 5 seconds via SSE without page reload
Dashboard shows system uptime

functional_requirements.title: Docker container monitor
functional_requirements.description: List all Docker containers with health indicators, per-container metrics, and auto-refresh every 10 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Lists all Docker containers (running, stopped, exited)
Shows per container: name, image, state, uptime, CPU%, memory used
Health indicator: green (running), grey (stopped), red (exited with error)
Data updates automatically every 10 seconds
Click on container shows expanded details (ports, volumes, environment)

functional_requirements.title: Systemd service monitor
functional_requirements.description: List all active/enabled Systemd services with status indicators, auto-refresh every 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Lists all active/enabled Systemd services
Shows per service: name, state (active/inactive/failed), active since
Visual indicator: green (active), grey (inactive), red (failed)
Filter to show only services with errors
Data updates every 30 seconds

functional_requirements.title: Threshold-based alert system
functional_requirements.description: Configurable alert rules for CPU, RAM, Disk, Temperature, and service state changes, with cooldown, severity levels, and SQLite persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable thresholds for CPU > X%, RAM > X%, Disk > X%, Temperature > X°C
Alerts when Docker container becomes unhealthy/exited
Alerts when Systemd service becomes failed
Alert history persisted in SQLite with timestamp and type
Alert panel with severity filters (critical, warning, info)
Configurable cooldown per alert rule to prevent spam (default: 15 min)
Severity levels: critical (red), warning (yellow), info (blue)

functional_requirements.title: Telegram notifications
functional_requirements.description: Send critical and warning alerts via Telegram Bot API, with test button and mute options.
acceptance_criteria: Configure Telegram Bot Token and Chat ID from the panel
Send critical and warning alerts via Telegram
Message includes: severity, affected metric/service, current value, configured threshold
Test button to verify Telegram connection
Option to mute notifications temporarily (1h, 4h, 24h)

functional_requirements.title: Email notifications
functional_requirements.description: Send critical alert emails via configurable SMTP with test button and optional daily digest.
acceptance_criteria: Configure SMTP settings (host, port, user, password, from, to)
Send emails for critical alerts
Email includes: problem summary, timestamp, current value vs threshold
Option to send daily digest with alert summary
Test button to verify SMTP configuration

functional_requirements.title: Authentication
functional_requirements.description: Single-admin login with bcrypt passwords, secure session cookies, and brute-force protection.
acceptance_criteria: Login screen with username and password
Single admin user configurable via env var or first-run setup
Secure cookie-based session with configurable expiry (default: 24h)
Brute-force protection: temporary lockout after 5 failed attempts (15 min)
Password hashed with bcrypt in the database
Logout button visible in header
All routes except /login and /health require authentication

functional_requirements.title: Service controls
functional_requirements.description: Start, Stop, Restart for Docker containers and Systemd services from the dashboard, with confirmation modal, async execution, and audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Start, Stop, Restart buttons per Docker container
Start, Stop, Restart buttons per Systemd service
Confirmation before executing Stop/Restart (confirmation modal)
Visual feedback of action result (success/error with message)
Action log with timestamps (audit trail) persisted in SQLite
Actions execute asynchronously and report result

functional_requirements.title: Dark mode UI
functional_requirements.description: Professional dark-mode interface with semantic color tokens, responsive layout, and consistent component patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Dark visual identity with subtle elevation and border hierarchy
Semantic color tokens: ok (green), warn (yellow), critical (red), muted (grey)
Consistent card, badge, button, and empty/error state patterns across modules
Mobile-responsive layout with touch targets ≥ 44×44 px
WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for all status text on dark backgrounds

functional_requirements.title: On-demand service logs
functional_requirements.description: View last 100 lines of logs for any Docker container or Systemd service without SSH.
acceptance_criteria: Log viewer for Docker containers (last 100 lines)
Log viewer for Systemd services (last 100 lines)
Accessible from service row in one click

functional_requirements.title: Privilege separation
functional_requirements.description: Web process runs unprivileged; host-level actions (service controls, system power) are delegated to a root-owned helper via Unix socket.
acceptance_criteria: Web process runs with NoNewPrivileges=true
Host-level actions routed through Unix socket to privileged helper
Privileged helper validates all commands before execution
No direct privileged execution from the web layer

functional_requirements.title: CSRF protection
functional_requirements.description: All state-changing requests require a valid CSRF token.
acceptance_criteria: CSRF token generated per session
Token validated on all POST/PUT/DELETE requests
Missing or invalid token returns 403

functional_requirements.title: Hardware integration (Pironman 5)
functional_requirements.description: Configure RGB lighting, fan modes, and OLED display for Pironman 5 enclosure from the settings panel.
acceptance_criteria: RGB mode selection from settings
Fan mode configuration from settings
OLED display configuration from settings

functional_requirements.title: VPN status (Tailscale)
functional_requirements.description: Display Tailscale VPN peer connectivity status on the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Show Tailscale node status
Show connected peers with name and IP
Status updates on dashboard load and SSE refresh

functional_requirements.title: Database backup
functional_requirements.description: Automated and manual encrypted backups of the SQLite database with configurable schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Manual backup trigger from settings
Automated backup on configurable interval
Backup encrypted at rest
Backup download from settings panel

non_functional_requirements.title: Resource footprint
non_functional_requirements.constraint: ~15 MB RAM at idle; minimal CPU impact on ARM Cortex-A (Raspberry Pi)

non_functional_requirements.title: Zero runtime dependencies
non_functional_requirements.constraint: Single statically-linked Go binary; no Node.js, Python, or other runtimes required

non_functional_requirements.title: ARM64 cross-compilation
non_functional_requirements.constraint: make build-arm must produce a working linux/arm64 binary

non_functional_requirements.title: Metrics update latency
non_functional_requirements.constraint: Critical dashboard metrics visible within 5 seconds of change
